newsitem.title: UK: Federal Express expands into Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express expands into Ireland.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it would invest $3 million and create 40 new jobs with the opening of a new operation to serve the Dublin market.
FedEx said in a statement the new 25,000 sq ft warehousing and office complex is based at Cloghran near Dublin airport.
It is designed to support Ireland's strong export economy with new jobs and service such as Fedex's "8am next day" next day delivery service to the U.S.
FedEx senior vice president and general manager for Europe, Middle East and Africa, David J Bronczek said " Ireland is one of Europe's strongest growth markets for international express services."

"With exports already accounting for over 70 percent of gross domestic product in a market that achieved over 10 percent GDP growth in 1995 alone, the demand for business services that connect the economy to its overseas customers is strong,"
